notes.title: Update 06_24_2025
notes.content: Added tutorial videos and voiceovers for game introduction. Managed a few minor bugs and tweaks that were identified during a few playtests. Boss no longer resides in the first level.

notes.title: Vertical Slice Update: Blight Upgrades & UI Overhaul
notes.content:
We’ve pushed a major update to the Blightened playtest build. Here’s what’s new:

💀 Blight Economy Unlocked
Collect blight to upgrade health and carry capacity. Choose how you grow — more survivability or resource control.

⚔️ Combat Improvements

Timing-based light attacks refined for a more responsive feel

Fixed hit windows and minor ability sync issues

Improved controller navigation and feedback

🧊 Front-End UI Rebuild
All new UI with new Settings, Resolution, and Controls interfaces

Controller support is much better 

Dropdown resolution selector

Adjust Audio

Toggle Fullscreen or Window

🔧 Additional Fixes

Audio mix now respects player settings

Resolution now defaults properly across multi-monitor setups

General polish across all menus and HUD transitions

Thanks to everyone playtesting and providing feedback — it’s making Blightened sharper each day.


Play now and let us know if you can break it. 🐛🔥Getting closer to an official demo here in a few weeks. Hoping its only 2 but the we want to add more polish to the visuals.

notes.title: 🔥 Playtest Update: A Volcanic Trial Awaits
notes.content:
The Blightened playtest just got hotter.

Explore the newly unlocked Volcanic Rupture — a hellish biome pulsing with molten platforms, burning traps, and corrupted architecture. This level introduces:

Lava geysers and timed flame bursts

Spiked crushers and chained scythe traps

Prison chambers buried in magma

Unforgiving platforming over lakes of fire

A haunting new aesthetic that cranks up the visual intensity

Welcome to Rupture Cycle: 32019 FA — 02:15:36:15
This timeline burns hotter than anything that came before.

Jump in, test your skills, and tell us what scorched you the most.
